examples.en: The moon landing inaugurated a new era in space exploration.
examples.zh: 登陆月球开创了太空探索的新纪元。

examples.en: China has earmarked more than $20 billion for oil exploration.
examples.zh: 中国已留出二百多亿美元用于石油勘探。

examples.en: His exploration of the myth brings insight into the American psyche.
examples.zh: 他对那个神话的探索揭示了美国人的心理。
